review.rationale: Option A correctly mandates a complete, hash-bound, offline-only 28-file contract package that closes all ten readiness-audit inputs without authorizing CE-G13 execution, public fetches, model sessions, or technical reuse runs. Cold discovery answer-key protection is enforced via immutable prompts that forbid expected filenames and secret leakage. Five role-specific Schemas enforce strict separation of discovery, architecture, reuse, recommendation, and boundary auditing, each requiring explicit non-claim invariants (Evidence!=Truth, Evaluation!=Authority, Recommendation!=Decision, Capability!=Permission). Public snapshot and retrieval contracts enforce same-origin lineage, byte caps, and admission gating. Reuse validation binds to frozen snapshots with explicit failure modes. Request capture enforces sanitized, credential-free, single-request-per-session boundaries. Composite results restrict PASS to fully bounded, website-only sufficiency with all non-claims false. The 24+ negative/mutation catalog provides sufficient coverage. Offline validation requires meta-schema compliance, hash integrity, and zero network/credential/model activity. All non-authorizations are explicit and comprehensive. Authority boundaries are preserved throughout.
